The Significance of One Eleven (January 11th) & The Japanese Concept of Ikigai“The Mystery of human existence lies not just in staying alive but in having something to live for.” — Fyodor Dostoyevsky –Jennifer ThompsonFollow4 min read·Jan 10, 2022642ListenShareSource: CanvaI love numbers. I was good in Math and Economics and was a financial advisor for over twenty years. So, yes, I love numbers. But I have always been skeptical about numerology.But, depending on where you are living in this world, today (if you live in Australia) or tomorrow (if you’re living in North America), it will be January 11th — 1–11.I looked up to see what it meant. I figured there’s nothing harmful with looking at symbols and signs, especially when it comes to numbers.Here is what I found out:One eleven is a day of high vibration and a day for manifesting.The number one represents independence and individuality. It’s a reference to the self. It’s also the number that symbolizes new beginnings and signifies the ability to let go and move forward. And the number one also represents the obvious, leadership and importance.The number eleven indicates a connection to the higher self, the spiritually aware part of your soul.Create an account to read the full story.The author made this story available to Medium members only.If you’re new to Medium, create a new account to read this story on us.Continue in appOr, continue in mobile webSign up with GoogleSign up with FacebookSign up with emailAlready have an account?
